newsitem.title: ESTONIA: BOURSE CONSIDERS TIGHTENING LISTING REQUIREMENTS.
newsitem.headline: BOURSE CONSIDERS TIGHTENING LISTING REQUIREMENTS.

text.p: The Tallinn stock exchange's listing commission has proposed that its listing requirements be tightened, a market participant said on Monday.

The proposal included stricter standards for the preparation of financial reports for companies on the main list of the stock exchange, a market participant, who wished to remain anonymous, told Reuters.
The Tallinn stock exchange declined to comment on possible changes in its listing criteria.
The listing commission meets on an ad hoc basis and makes recommendations for the bourse's board.
The date for the next stock exchange board meeting has not yet been set.
